A test script is the implementation of a test case. For automated testing, test scripts are commonly written in computer programming languages. The test case defines how functionality is validated; a test script contains the instructions to validate that the functionality behaves as expected. For manual testing, a test script contains textual step-by-step instructions to perform what is specified in the test case.
• A test case usually has one but could potentially have more than one test script
To implement test cases in an efficient and effective manner.
• A test script may not be necessary in situations where manual testing is being performed and step-by-step instructions are already defined in the test case
